bootstrap.sampling: for replicate b=0..1999 call the bound map_weighted_cluster_bootstrap_replicate with seed=2026073005+b; sample exactly K sorted observed cluster IDs uniformly with replacement, carry cluster totals and map counts, then compute sampled_total/sampled_count
bootstrap.statistic: delta_i=LL_B0_i-LL_D1_i; point estimate=sum_i(delta_i)/n over locked-candidate VALIDATION maps

numerical_objective.domain: unbounded finite real logits; no logit or probability clipping; stable softplus is numpy.logaddexp and stable sigmoid is scipy.special.expit
numerical_objective.eta: z_i=eta_B0_i+x_i^T beta; eta_B0_i and every x_i coordinate must be finite, y_i in {0,1}
numerical_objective.failure: nonfinite input/objective/analytic gradient/Hessian, solver failure, or gradient infinity norm above tolerance is EXECUTION_BLOCKED:SOLVER_OR_OBJECTIVE_FAILURE, never candidate loss or NO_INCREMENTAL_DRAFT_WINNER
numerical_objective.gradient: g(beta)=X^T(scipy.special.expit(z)-y)+Lambda beta; analytic jacobian is passed to L-BFGS-B; finite differences are forbidden
numerical_objective.hessian: H_MAP=X^T diag(p_i*(1-p_i)) X+Lambda at converged TRAIN MAP, with p_i=scipy.special.expit(z_i)
numerical_objective.penalty_diagonal: Lambda_j=12.5 for every mu coordinate and 50.0 for every fitted delta coordinate

priors_and_penalty.identifiability: proper independent Gaussian priors define the mu/delta decomposition; no sum-to-zero constraint is imposed

solver.determinism: single deterministic call; no random restart

selection.DEVELOPMENT: one paired mean-map-log-loss comparison; select D1 iff mean(LL_B0-LL_D1)>0, otherwise select B0; lock immediately
selection.TRAIN: B0 state learning, D1 vocabulary/design/offsets/fit, priors, penalties, and transformations only
selection.VALIDATION: evaluate the locked candidate exactly once; no refit, reselection, tuning, threshold change, or reuse

availability.D2: omitted: no pair feature, pair estimate, synergy explanation, or missing-pair default exists
availability.prior_only_coordinate_rules: a prior-only (role,champion) delta is absent from beta and C, is counted once, and must not be inserted into fitted covariance; global champion uniqueness means it cannot repeat, otherwise EXECUTION_BLOCKED:PRIOR_ONLY_ROLE_DELTA_DUPLICATED
availability.seen_champion_unseen_exact_role: use absent fitted-delta point contribution 0.0 and independent conditional prior variance 0.01 exactly; ledger flag PRIOR_ONLY_ROLE_DELTA; never silently treat as observed-role evidence

invariances.reconciliation: the ten signed champion logit contributions sum to d_D1 within absolute tolerance 1e-12; otherwise EXECUTION_BLOCKED:CONTRIBUTION_RECONCILIATION_FAILURE
invariances.record_order: input-record order with fixed roles is invariant after canonical (side, role) sorting
invariances.side_swap: eta_B0_mean and d_D1 change sign, eta_B0_variance and Var_D1(d) are unchanged, and each logistic-normal probability complements exactly

parameter_uncertainty.B0: accepted G2 latent/player posterior mean and variance; use accepted logistic-normal posterior-predictive primitive for each point score
parameter_uncertainty.D1: conditional-on-frozen-B0 Laplace covariance C=(X'WX+diag(lambda))^-1 at the converged TRAIN MAP only
parameter_uncertainty.D1_conditional_variance: Var_D1(d)=x_fitted^T C x_fitted+0.01*N_prior_only_role_deltas; N_prior_only_role_deltas counts unique absent fitted (role,champion) delta coordinates only
parameter_uncertainty.interval: D1 conditional 95% logit interval d_D1 +/- 1.959963984540054*sqrt(Var_D1(d)); report separately from B0 uncertainty
parameter_uncertainty.prior_only_ledger: aggregate result emits prior_only_role_delta_count and prior_only_role_slot_membership_sha256 over canonical sorted internal (source_side,role,stable_champion_id) slots; raw slot IDs are never emitted
parameter_uncertainty.prohibition: do not report a total B0+D1 interval or assume their independence
regularity: finite symmetric Hessian within absolute tolerance 1e-12
finite nonnegative diagonal and quadratic forms
